sonnet.problem: This story card hints at the answer to the choice card that follows. 'Jesus does what plenty of us do when somebody else is steering' points straight to sleeping, so the True/False question about whether Jesus stays awake can be answered from the card before it. The text of this card never says what Jesus does; the next card asks it and the card after that tells it.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The right answer 'To the other side of the lake' is the only one that isn't a named town. The two wrong answers are both 'the town of ...' places, so the right one stands out. It also isn't the same kind of thing as the other two answers.
sonnet.rule: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone.

sonnet.problem: This true/false statement tests two claims at once: the spirit seized him many times, and the chains held him. It also adds 'people' as the ones who bound him, but the text only says 'he was bound with chains and shackles.'
sonnet.rule: A true or false statement tests one claim.
